notablePrerequisites:
Ghave has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least two Saprolings.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ghave, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.
